tools.name: extract_data
tools.description: Extract structured data from an image using a predefined layout. Uses AI cascade strategy for optimal cost-accuracy balance.

tools.name: list_layouts
tools.description: List all available extraction layouts with their field definitions

tools.name: get_extraction
tools.description: Get the result of a previous extraction by ID. Returns extracted data, a signed URL for downloading the original image (valid for 1 hour), and error_message if the extraction failed (e.g. inappropriate_content, prohibited_content, low_confidence).

tools.name: list_extractions
tools.description: List OCR extractions filtered by project and date range. Failed extractions include error_message field indicating the failure reason (e.g. scan.error.inappropriate_content, scan.error.low_confidence).

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all projects with their layouts and field definitions

tools.name: update_extraction
tools.description: Update the extracted data of an extraction result

tools.name: delete_extraction
tools.description: Delete an extraction result. A parent (root) ID deletes the whole upload (parent and all records); a record ID deletes only that record and renumbers the rest. Deleting an extraction that superseded an older extraction of the same file makes the older one current again.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project with layout options

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update an existing project

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Delete a project (soft delete)

tools.name: create_layout
tools.description: Create a new layout with field definitions. The created layout can be assigned to a project via create_project.

tools.name: update_layout
tools.description: Update an existing layout (replaces all fields)

tools.name: delete_layout
tools.description: Delete a layout (soft delete)

tools.name: generate_recipe
tools.description: Analyze a sample file and generate layout proposals. Accepts images, PDF, CSV, Excel (xlsx), Markdown, and plain text (e.g. a layout specification document). AI automatically detects the document type and suggests appropriate field definitions. Requires Standard plan or higher. Daily limit: 50 uses.

tools.name: create_layout_from_recipe
tools.description: Create a new layout from a recipe proposal. Use the output from generate_recipe to create a layout.

tools.name: export_extractions
tools.description: Export extraction data to CSV or Excel format. Returns base64-encoded file data.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List all available system templates (business_card, invoice, receipt, etc.) with their field definitions

tools.name: import_template
tools.description: Import a system template as a new layout for your account

tools.name: get_usage_stats
tools.description: Get current month's usage statistics including extraction count, remaining free extractions, and success rate

tools.name: get_billing_info
tools.description: Get billing information for a specific month including invoice amount and billable extraction count from Stripe

tools.name: check_fields
tools.description: Validate field definitions for AI extractability. Returns confidence score and improvement suggestions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_extraction · Private data: delete_extraction, generate_recipe, export_extractions · Public sink: delete_extraction · Destructive: delete_extraction, delete_project, delete_layout, export_extractions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_extraction · Private data: delete_extraction, generate_recipe, export_extractions · Public sink: delete_extraction · Destructive: delete_extraction, delete_project, delete_layout, export_extractions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
